method: 4 parallel read-only Explore agents across 7 audit layers + lifecycle congruence; every finding adversarially re-verified by hand against the live tree before remediation.
stack_note: Audit mapped the pasted SQL/FastAPI framing onto the actual Django 5.x + RLS(app.current_school_id) + Bootstrap/.rmc-* stack. No parallel SQL monolith, no FastAPI orchestrator, no app.current_tenant_id, no connections.databases per-request mutation were introduced (all on the prompt's reject list).

findings.finding: Payment status set via fragile positional index Payment.STATUS_CHOICES[2][0] ('completed') — breaks silently if the choices list is reordered.
validate_unified_transition() existed but was never called from any production path (dead code) — a buggy signal could record an illegal state jump (e.g. draft->purged).
findings.fix: Wired the validator into record_unified_transition(): resolve current unified state, refuse illegal transitions (log + skip, best-effort, never raise to preserve the signal-layer contract).

findings.finding: hierarchy_link_would_cycle() existed but was only called from tests — School.parent_school could be saved into a cycle (A->B, B->A), hanging every ancestor-chain / hierarchy_path walk.
findings.fix: School.clean() now calls hierarchy_link_would_cycle(self, parent_school_id) and raises ValidationError on a cycle. No migration.

findings.finding: derive_default_region() silently returned 'global' for any country with no mapping/override — a real country code could breach an unconfigured data-residency requirement with zero signal.
findings.fix: Added logger.warning on the global fallback for a non-empty unmapped code, pointing operators at the RuntimeDefaults override key. Behavior unchanged; observability added.

findings.finding: Active-nav indicators used physical border-left/margin-left/padding-left with no RTL companion — indicator lands on the wrong side under dir=rtl.
findings.fix: Converted to logical properties (border-inline-start / margin-inline-start / padding-inline-start). Identical in LTR; mirrors correctly in RTL. SW bumped.

findings.finding: The destructive purge (Celery beat, no request middleware) runs without an RLS context. Under FORCE RLS + default-deny (migration 0026: allow only when app.rls_bypass='on' OR school_id matches app.current_school_id), tenant-scoped child-row deletes could be silently denied (0 rows affected) when neither GUC is set.
findings.reason: Security-boundary destructive-path change. Cannot be validated locally — RLS is Postgres-only and is a no-op on the SQLite test DB, so any change here is unverifiable in CI. Changing it also alters destructive-delete behavior in prod and warrants owner review + a Postgres integration test before merge.
findings.recommended_fix: Wrap the purge deletion block in `with rls_school(school.id):` (apps/schools/rls_context.py) — scopes RLS to exactly the target tenant so deletes are permitted AND a bug cannot reach another tenant's rows. Verify the Celery worker DB role on Postgres first (if it is BYPASSRLS the issue is moot).

findings.finding: School has no index on (deleted_at, is_active) for grace-period purge scans; large fleets full-scan.
findings.reason: Migration-class item — per standing constraint, migration-class changes are flagged for the migration wave (D9/D10), not folded into a code wave whose hunks interleave with 300+ pre-existing modified files.

findings.finding: onboarding_service.py create path does not call set_creation_path; tenant defaults to creation_path=operator via inference.
findings.reason: Metadata-hygiene only; get_creation_path already infers from rmc_public_onboarding. Self-serve signup (signup_views.py:618) and rapid-create (views_rapid_create.py) both set it correctly. Mislabeling risk if changed without knowing the caller's intent — owner decision.

findings.finding: Provisioning can stall: COMPLETED event only logged on success; some failure exits leave no terminal (COMPLETED|FAILED) event, so unified_lifecycle stays in provisioning indefinitely with no explicit STUCK signal.
findings.reason: Touches task failure semantics + needs a regression test; out of scope for the finance/lifecycle congruence pass. Recommended: always emit a terminal event in a finally/except, add a stuck-provisioning watch (a tasks_stall_watch.py already exists — wire it).

findings.finding: If dispatch_provision_school fails post-verify, the user is still logged in and redirected to the dashboard — sees a half-provisioned school that never finishes.
findings.reason: Product/UX policy decision (error page vs auto-retry vs degraded-banner). Owner decision.

dismissed_false_positives.verdict: FALSE POSITIVE — it intentionally assigns the same overall completion percent to every step; the agent's 'fix' is behaviorally identical.
FALSE POSITIVE — exists only in a stale worktree; active tree resolves grading polymorphically.
CLEAN — scan_money_float baseline 0; all float() sites carry money-float-allow markers (ratios/display/gateway).
CLEAN — zero eval()/exec() on user input in apps/evals or apps/academics.

verified_correct: RLS FORCE coverage (migration 0048) + default-deny policies across 8 apps; GUC is app.current_school_id (correct), no connections.databases per-request mutation.
Double-entry ledger posting functions are @transaction.atomic and balance debits==credits (test_ledger_failures).
PPP coefficients read from siteconfig CountryMultiplier (DB), not hardcoded.
Metering: realtime_meter.hot_increment (atomic HINCRBY + Lua HGETALL+DEL drain + ORM fallback + TTL guard); both Celery beats wired (billing-flush-realtime-meter 60s, billing-flush-ai-metrics 5min).
Offboarding purge gates: export-before-purge + grace period + legal hold + dual approval + audit mirror all present.
GDPR/DSAR export auth-gated to tenant admin/operator.
Command palette (rmc-command-palette.js) wired; modal a11y (role/aria-modal/aria-labelledby) correct on confirm_modal.html.
Currency/country lists centralized in registries; role strings via TextChoices.
